parent_model_scope: DEV24+VAL48 development evidence; not independent validation; this trial adds no training.
scope: Fixed 12-scene DEV/VAL development screen; the parent GRU used DEV24+VAL48 development evidence, VAL is not independent validation, and this study adds no training.

metric_definitions.Q_m: RMS Euclidean position error over all 20001 state samples.
metric_definitions.task_SO3_rad: SO(3) geodesic RMSE against task attitude reconstructed by the frozen FULL72 metric scorer.
metric_definitions.inner_SO3_rad: SO(3) geodesic RMSE against filtered_attitude_reference over 20000 transitions.
metric_definitions.macro_mean: Arithmetic mean of the per-scene metric over completed rows in that group.

raw_wind_grouping: ZERO_RAW_WIND iff every stored component of candidate raw scene/environment_wind_I equals exactly zero; otherwise NONZERO_RAW_WIND. ID-based W15/HF/W00-W08 groups are reported separately.
run_identity_binding: Candidate raw is scored only after run_start binds release, source/input manifests, parent manifest, scene payload, B raw, C5 input lock, source lock, cosine GRU model/normalizer, tau=0.1 s, rho=0.1, and changed delayed-prediction path. B/C5 raw and status hashes are bound by SCENE_INPUT_MANIFEST_v1.json.
